name: Aeval
design_goal: Strong space control and recovery mixups, weak point blank pressure. Wins neutral through water placement rather than raw frame advantage.

balance_targets.identity: light, floaty, good midrange, mediocre close range
balance_targets.power_budget: projectiles and positional control are stronger than raw grounded normals
counterplay: do not let whirlpool become a free escape
red_flags: dspecial both traps and kills too early
uspecial grants excessive safety after recovery

utilt.change_2026_09_29: startup 6 to 10, total 24 to 30: the anti-air was too fast to challenge from above; anim holds moved so the javelin frame starts on frame 10

usmash.change_2026_09_29: startup 12 to 16, total 40 to 46: a kill move that also covered landings on reaction; anim holds moved to match

nair.role: fast body-centred bubble and combo bridge into tilts
nair.change_2026_09_29: startup 5 to 3, clean 3-6 then weaker late hit to 20, r 16 at x 6 to r 22 at the body centre, landing lag 8 to 5, lower knockback: it was too slow and too small to be an out of shield or combo tool

fair.change_2026_09_29: damage 10 to 11.5, reach 35 to 41 (tip circle added): the main spacer lost too many trades at its own range

bair.change_2026_09_29: damage 11 to 12.5, reach 34 to 41 (tip circle added): the retreating aerial should win at the range it is thrown from

uair.change_2026_09_29: damage 9 to 8, startup 8 to 10, total 30 to 33, landing lag 11 to 12, javelin top -114 to -110: juggles were too safe and rewarding
uair.change_2026_09_30: startup 10 to 14, active 10-14 to 14-18, total 33 to 37 (endlag unchanged): the owner wants it slower still; anim holds [5,5,7,16] to [7,7,7,16] so the javelin crop lands on frame 14

dair.role: dive smash: invulnerable straight drop, spike on contact
dair.change_2026_09_29: bounces on a body hit like the SSBU dair hop: vy -3.5 (short hop), air dodge back, actionable 10 frames after hitlag instead of 20 more move frames
dair.activeNote: pinned on frame 6 for the whole dive, so the spike is out until it meets a fighter, a shield or the ground

dive.horizontal: vx zeroed every dive frame, one frame of air acceleration (0.14 px) is the only drift
dive.invulnerable: every dive frame, none in the landing lag
dive.ends: a hit on a fighter or shield, the ground (20 frames landing lag), or the blast zone

dair.change_2026_09_30: dive smash: startup 12 to 6, then an invulnerable 7 px/frame drop until contact or ground; damage 12 to 14, angle 270 to 275, bkb 30 to 50, kbg 85 to 80; landing lag 16 to 20; total 36 to 30; off a shield it bounces but acts 15 frames after hitlag (about -4); owner request

nspecial.power: always 1 (the charged lerp is the only charge scaling)
nspecial.change_2026_09_29: tap cast frame 11 to 9 and move 40 to 31, chargeCastFrames 16 to 12 (full charge fires on 21, was 27; move 43, was 56); charge length unchanged. A direct orb hit heals Aeval 35 percent of the damage dealt, floor 0
nspecial.change_2026_09_30: tap cast frame 9 to 3 and move 31 to 12 (about a third); chargeCastFrames 12 unchanged, so a full charge fires on 15 of 24 (was 21 of 43). The 60-frame hold to full charge (TUNING.input.chargeMax, shared with smashes) already exceeds the 24-frame charged cast, so the hold is unchanged. Reading of the owner line: the charge and attack should be equal if not more charge

sspecial.fighterMovement: none (the +2 vx on frame 8 was removed)
sspecial.change_2026_09_30: one crescent at a time (a press while hers is out does nothing, she stays actionable); total 42 to 30 with the frame 10 spawn unchanged, so she leaves the throw pose 12 frames sooner; kbg 44 to 40 (KO 197 to 220, kb at 100 71.2 to 66.9) for a shorter victim tumble; a shield now breaks it

dspecial.role: space control trap, not a free kill
dspecial.change_2026_09_30: lifesteal: each hit that lands on a body heals Aeval half its damage, the orb drain rule; 0.5 rather than the orb 0.35 because it is a committal multi-hit trap worth 10 at most

character_scaling_system.principle: Each character should be tuned from shared normalized budgets instead of ad hoc numbers.

axes.meaning: ability to act first after contact

character_scaling_system.tuning_rule: Start each new fighter from an archetype budget. Spend advantage in one or two dimensions and visibly tax another dimension. Do not give a fighter top tier speed, range, kill power, recovery, and frame advantage simultaneously.
